text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
......Away again, are they? I wonder where 
they are and what they're up to.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry, Orfe. I've been making you 
worry...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(However, the current me is not worthy of 
being reflected in Orfe's beautiful 
eyes...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I stepped on the scale for the first time 
in a while, but... This is... I see."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(...The cause must be all those 
consecutive business dinners with external 
vendors. I couldn't very well leave food 
on my plate at a social gathering...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(So that I can be someone worthy of 
standing by Orfe's side...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey used every trick in the book 
and quickly returned to her original 
weight.
